title: Clear the Road to d4
setup: A reversed Sicilian: Black has just put the bishop on c5, level with its pawn on e5. Take that pawn, trusting a pawn fork to win the piece back.
hint: Two black units stand on squares one pawn push could hit at once — but something is standing in the way first.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black's bishop on c5 and pawn on e5 sit on the two squares a pawn on d4 would hit together, but the e5 pawn guards d4, so a piece has to clear it first.

{{Nxe5}} does that. After {{Nxe5}}, {{d4}} forks the knight and the bishop, and White wins the piece back. Material ends roughly level, but White keeps the center and a small edge.

A flank opening still wins its fights in the middle. It just takes the long way around.
